verses.original: דִּבְרֵ֣י עָמ֔וֹס אֲשֶׁר־ הָיָ֥ה בַנֹּקְדִ֖ים מִתְּק֑וֹעַ אֲשֶׁר֩ חָזָ֨ה עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל בִּימֵ֣י׀ עֻזִיָּ֣ה מֶֽלֶךְ־ יְהוּדָ֗ה וּבִימֵ֞י יָרָבְעָ֤ם בֶּן־ יוֹאָשׁ֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל שְׁנָתַ֖יִם לִפְנֵ֥י הָרָֽעַשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: diḇ·rê ‘ā·mō·ws ’ă·šer- hā·yāh ḇan·nō·qə·ḏîm mit·tə·qō·w·a‘ ’ă·šer ḥā·zāh ‘al- yiś·rā·’êl bî·mê ʿu·zī·yå̄h me·leḵ- yə·hū·ḏāh ū·ḇî·mê yā·rā·ḇə·‘ām ben- yō·w·’āš me·leḵ yiś·rā·’êl šə·nā·ṯa·yim lip̄·nê hā·rā·‘aš
verses.literal: These are the words of Amos who was among the sheepherders of Tekoa what he saw concerning Israel two years before the earthquake in the days when Uzziah was king of Judah . . . and Jeroboam son of Jehoash was king of Israel
verses.literalPt: AS palavras de Amós, que estava entre os pastores de Tecoa, as quais viu a respeito de Israel, nos dias de Uzias, rei de Judá, e nos dias de Jeroboão, filho de Joás, rei de Israel, dois anos antes do terremoto.

verses.original: וַיֹּאמַ֓ר׀ יְהוָה֙ מִצִיּ֣וֹן יִשְׁאָ֔ג וּמִירוּשָׁלִַ֖ם יִתֵּ֣ן קוֹל֑וֹ וְאָֽבְלוּ֙ נְא֣וֹת הָרֹעִ֔ים וְיָבֵ֖שׁ רֹ֥אשׁ הַכַּרְמֶֽל׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mar Yah·weh mi·ṣī·yōn yiš·’āḡ ū·mî·rū·šā·lim yit·tên qō·w·lōw wə·’ā·ḇə·lū nə·’ō·wṯ hā·rō·‘îm wə·yā·ḇêš rōš hak·kar·mel
verses.literal: He said The LORD roars from Zion and raises His voice from Jerusalem the pastures of the shepherds mourn and the summit of Carmel withers
verses.literalPt: Ele disse: O SENHOR bramará de Sião, e de Jerusalém fará ouvir a sua voz; os prados dos pastores prantearão, e secar-se-á o cume do Carmelo.

verses.original: כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה עַל־ שְׁלֹשָׁה֙ פִּשְׁעֵ֣י דַמֶּ֔שֶׂק וְעַל־ אַרְבָּעָ֖ה לֹ֣א אֲשִׁיבֶ֑נּוּ עַל־ דּוּשָׁ֛ם בַּחֲרֻצ֥וֹת הַבַּרְזֶ֖ל אֶת־ הַגִּלְעָֽד׃
verses.transliteration: kōh ’ā·mar Yah·weh ‘al- šə·lō·šāh piš·‘ê ḏam·me·śeq wə·‘al- ’ar·bā·‘āh lō ’ă·šî·ḇen·nū ‘al- dū·šām ba·ḥă·ru·ṣō·wṯ hab·bar·zel ’eṯ- hag·gil·‘āḏ
verses.literal: This is what the LORD says For three transgressions of Damascus even four I will not revoke My judgment because they threshed Gilead with sledges of iron
verses.literalPt: Assim diz o SENHOR: Por três transgressões de Damasco, e por quatro, não retirarei o castigo, porque trilharam a Gileade com trilhos de ferro.

verses.original: וְשִׁלַּ֥חְתִּי אֵ֖שׁ בְּבֵ֣ית חֲזָאֵ֑ל וְאָכְלָ֖ה אַרְמְנ֥וֹת בֶּן־ הֲדָֽד׃
verses.transliteration: wə·šil·laḥ·tî ’êš bə·ḇêṯ ḥă·zā·’êl wə·’ā·ḵə·lāh ’ar·mə·nō·wṯ ben- hă·ḏāḏ
verses.literal: So I will send fire upon the house of Hazael to consume the citadels of Ben-hadad
verses.literalPt: Por isso porei fogo à casa de Hazael, e ele consumirá os palácios de Ben-Hadade.

verses.original: וְשָֽׁבַרְתִּי֙ בְּרִ֣יחַ דַּמֶּ֔שֶׂק וְהִכְרַתִּ֤י יוֹשֵׁב֙ מִבִּקְעַת־ אָ֔וֶן וְתוֹמֵ֥ךְ שֵׁ֖בֶט מִבֵּ֣ית עֶ֑דֶן וְגָל֧וּ עַם־ אֲרָ֛ם קִ֖ירָה אָמַ֥ר יְהוָֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·šā·ḇar·tî bə·rî·aḥ dam·me·śeq wə·hiḵ·rat·tî yō·wō·šêḇ mib·biq·‘aṯ- ’ā·wen wə·ṯō·w·mêḵ šê·ḇeṭ mib·bêṯ ‘e·ḏen wə·ḡā·lū ‘am- ’ă·rām qî·rāh ’ā·mar Yah·weh
verses.literal: I will break down the gates of Damascus I will cut off the ruler from the Valley of Aven . . . and the one who wields the scepter in Beth-eden . . . The people of Aram will be exiled to Kir says the LORD
verses.literalPt: E quebrarei o ferrolho de Damasco, e exterminarei o morador do vale de Áven, e ao que tem o cetro de Bete-Éden; e o povo da Síria será levado em cativeiro a Quir, diz o SENHOR.

verses.original: כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה עַל־ שְׁלֹשָׁה֙ פִּשְׁעֵ֣י עַזָּ֔ה וְעַל־ אַרְבָּעָ֖ה לֹ֣א אֲשִׁיבֶ֑נּוּ עַל־ הַגְלוֹתָ֛ם גָּל֥וּת שְׁלֵמָ֖ה לְהַסְגִּ֥יר לֶאֱדֽוֹם׃
verses.transliteration: kōh ’ā·mar Yah·weh ‘al- šə·lō·šāh piš·‘ê ‘az·zāh wə·‘al- ’ar·bā·‘āh lō ’ă·šî·ḇen·nū ‘al- haḡ·lō·w·ṯām gā·lūṯ šə·lê·māh lə·has·gîr le·’ĕ·ḏō·wm
verses.literal: This is what the LORD says For three transgressions of Gaza even four I will not revoke My judgment because they exiled a whole population delivering them up to Edom
verses.literalPt: Assim diz o SENHOR: Por três transgressões de Gaza, e por quatro, não retirarei o castigo, porque levaram em cativeiro todos os cativos para os entregarem a Edom.

verses.original: וְשִׁלַּ֥חְתִּי אֵ֖שׁ בְּחוֹמַ֣ת עַזָּ֑ה וְאָכְלָ֖ה אַרְמְנֹתֶֽיהָ׃
verses.literal: So I will send fire upon the walls of Gaza to consume its citadels
verses.literalPt: Por isso porei fogo ao muro de Gaza, e ele consumirá os seus palácios.

verses.original: וְהִכְרַתִּ֤י יוֹשֵׁב֙ מֵֽאַשְׁדּ֔וֹד וְתוֹמֵ֥ךְ שֵׁ֖בֶט מֵֽאַשְׁקְל֑וֹן וַהֲשִׁיב֨וֹתִי יָדִ֜י עַל־ עֶקְר֗וֹן וְאָֽבְדוּ֙ שְׁאֵרִ֣ית פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים אָמַ֖ר אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·hiḵ·rat·tî yō·wō·šêḇ mê·’aš·dō·wḏ wə·ṯō·w·mêḵ šê·ḇeṭ mê·’aš·qə·lō·wn wa·hă·šî·ḇō·w·ṯî yā·ḏî ‘al- ‘eq·rō·wn wə·’ā·ḇə·ḏū šə·’ê·rîṯ pə·liš·tîm ’ā·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh
verses.literal: I will cut off the ruler of Ashdod and the one who wields the scepter in Ashkelon I will turn My hand against Ekron and the remnant of the Philistines will perish says the Lord GOD
verses.literalPt: E exterminarei o morador de Asdode, e o que tem o cetro de Ascalom, e tornarei a minha mão contra Ecrom; e o restante dos filisteus perecerá, diz o Senhor DEUS.

verses.original: כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה עַל־ שְׁלֹשָׁה֙ פִּשְׁעֵי־ צֹ֔ר וְעַל־ אַרְבָּעָ֖ה לֹ֣א אֲשִׁיבֶ֑נּוּ עַֽל־ הַסְגִּירָ֞ם גָּל֤וּת שְׁלֵמָה֙ לֶאֱד֔וֹם וְלֹ֥א זָכְר֖וּ בְּרִ֥ית אַחִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: kōh ’ā·mar Yah·weh ‘al- šə·lō·šāh piš·‘ê- ṣōr wə·‘al- ’ar·bā·‘āh lō ’ă·šî·ḇen·nū ‘al- has·gî·rām gā·lūṯ šə·lê·māh le·’ĕ·ḏō·wm wə·lō zā·ḵə·rū bə·rîṯ ’a·ḥîm
verses.literal: This is what the LORD says For three transgressions of Tyre even four I will not revoke My judgment because they delivered up a whole congregation of exiles to Edom and broke . . . a covenant of brotherhood
verses.literalPt: Assim diz o SENHOR: Por três transgressões de Tiro, e por quatro, não retirarei o castigo, porque entregaram todos os cativos a Edom, e não se lembraram da aliança dos irmãos.

verses.original: וְשִׁלַּ֥חְתִּי אֵ֖שׁ בְּח֣וֹמַת צֹ֑ר וְאָכְלָ֖ה אַרְמְנֹתֶֽיהָ׃פ
verses.literal: So I will send fire upon the walls of Tyre to consume its citadels
verses.literalPt: Por isso porei fogo ao muro de Tiro, e ele consumirá os seus palácios.

verses.original: כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה עַל־ שְׁלֹשָׁה֙ פִּשְׁעֵ֣י אֱד֔וֹם וְעַל־ אַרְבָּעָ֖ה לֹ֣א אֲשִׁיבֶ֑נּוּ עַל־ רָדְפ֨וֹ בַחֶ֤רֶב אָחִיו֙ וְשִׁחֵ֣ת רַחֲמָ֔יו וַיִּטְרֹ֤ף לָעַד֙ אַפּ֔וֹ וְעֶבְרָת֖וֹ שְׁמָ֥רָה נֶֽצַח׃
verses.transliteration: kōh ’ā·mar Yah·weh ‘al- šə·lō·šāh piš·‘ê ’ĕ·ḏō·wm wə·‘al- ’ar·bā·‘āh lō ’ă·šî·ḇen·nū ‘al- rā·ḏə·p̄ōw ḇa·ḥe·reḇ ’ā·ḥîw wə·ši·ḥêṯ ra·ḥă·māw way·yiṭ·rōp̄ lā·‘aḏ ’ap·pōw wə·‘eḇ·rā·ṯōw šə·mā·rāh ne·ṣaḥ
verses.literal: This is what the LORD says For three transgressions of Edom even four I will not revoke My judgment because he pursued his brother with the sword and stifled all compassion his anger raged continually and his fury flamed incessantly
verses.literalPt: Assim diz o SENHOR: Por três transgressões de Edom, e por quatro, não retirarei o castigo, porque perseguiu a seu irmão à espada, e aniquilou as suas misericórdias; e a sua ira despedaçou eternamente, e conservou a sua indignação para sempre.

verses.original: וְשִׁלַּ֥חְתִּי אֵ֖שׁ בְּתֵימָ֑ן וְאָכְלָ֖ה אַרְמְנ֥וֹת בָּצְרָֽה׃פ
verses.literal: So I will send fire upon Teman to consume the citadels of Bozrah
verses.literalPt: Por isso porei fogo a Temã, e ele consumirá os palácios de Bozra.

verses.original: כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה עַל־ שְׁלֹשָׁה֙ פִּשְׁעֵ֣י בְנֵֽי־ עַמּ֔וֹן וְעַל־ אַרְבָּעָ֖ה לֹ֣א אֲשִׁיבֶ֑נּוּ עַל־ בִּקְעָם֙ הָר֣וֹת הַגִּלְעָ֔ד לְמַ֖עַן הַרְחִ֥יב אֶת־ גְּבוּלָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kōh ’ā·mar Yah·weh ‘al- šə·lō·šāh piš·‘ê ḇə·nê- ‘am·mō·wn wə·‘al- ’ar·bā·‘āh lō ’ă·šî·ḇen·nū ‘al- biq·‘ām hā·rō·wṯ hag·gil·‘āḏ lə·ma·‘an har·ḥîḇ ’eṯ- gə·ḇū·lām
verses.literal: This is what the LORD says For three transgressions of the Ammonites . . . even four I will not revoke My judgment because they ripped open the pregnant women of Gilead in order to enlarge their territory
verses.literalPt: Assim diz o SENHOR: Por três transgressões dos filhos de Amom, e por quatro, não retirarei o castigo, porque fenderam o ventre às grávidas de Gileade, para dilatarem os seus termos.

verses.original: וְהִצַּ֤תִּי אֵשׁ֙ בְּחוֹמַ֣ת רַבָּ֔ה וְאָכְלָ֖ה אַרְמְנוֹתֶ֑יהָ בִּתְרוּעָה֙ בְּי֣וֹם מִלְחָמָ֔ה בְּסַ֖עַר בְּי֥וֹם סוּפָֽה
verses.transliteration: wə·hiṣ·ṣat·tî ’êš bə·ḥō·w·maṯ rab·bāh wə·’ā·ḵə·lāh ’ar·mə·nō·w·ṯe·hā biṯ·rū·‘āh bə·yō·wm mil·ḥā·māh bə·sa·‘ar bə·yō·wm sū·p̄å̄h
verses.literal: So I will kindle a fire in the walls of Rabbah to consume its citadels amid war cries on the day of battle and a violent wind on the day of tempest
verses.literalPt: Por isso porei fogo ao muro de Rabá, e ele consumirá os seus palácios, com alarido no dia da batalha, com tempestade no dia da tormenta.

verses.original: וְהָלַ֥ךְ מַלְכָּ֖ם בַּגּוֹלָ֑ה ה֧וּא וְשָׂרָ֛יו יַחְדָּ֖ו אָמַ֥ר יְהוָֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·laḵ mal·kām bag·gō·w·lāh hū wə·śā·rāw yaḥ·dāw ’ā·mar Yah·weh
verses.literal: Their king will go into exile he and his princes together says the LORD
verses.literalPt: E o seu rei irá para o cativeiro, ele e os seus príncipes juntamente, diz o SENHOR.
